## Key Projects
1. **macOS Big Sur Web Desktop** (Current Project):
   - Pixel-perfect recreation of macOS Big Sur running in the browser.
   - Features: Window management, traffic lights, dock minimization with live window thumbnails, Launchpad, Spotlight search, Notification Center with live stocks and weather widgets, System Settings, Terminal, Calculator, PDF Viewer with resume preview.
   - Web API Integrations:
     - **Presentation API & Remote Playback / Cast**: Screen Mirroring & Cast to wireless displays.
     - **Web Bluetooth API**: Device scanning & pairing in System Settings > Bluetooth.
     - **Web Battery API**: Live hardware battery level and charging status in Menu Bar and System Settings.
     - **Origin Private File System (OPFS)**: High-performance sandboxed local file storage with Service Worker caching.
     - **Web Speech Synthesis API**: VoiceOver accessibility reader in System Settings > Accessibility.
     - **Web Fullscreen API**: Windowed / Full-screen switching in System Settings > Displays.
     - **Web Storage Estimate API**: Real-time quota and disk usage calculation.

2. **Sacred Texts** (https://sacred-texts.xyz):
   - Ancient text exploration and restoration platform.

3. **AlgoViz** (https://algorithms.sacred-texts.xyz):
   - Interactive algorithm and data structure visualizer.

4. **SpeakSpanish** (https://sp4nish.vercel.app):
   - Language learning application with conversational voice drills.

5. **Toonflix** (https://t00nflix.vercel.app):
   - Streaming catalog and media experience for animated features.

## Accessibility & Standards
- Built to WCAG AAA standards with skip-navigation landmarks, ARIA live regions, keyboard navigation (Tab/Shift+Tab/Enter/Escape/Arrows), high color contrast, and prefers-reduced-motion support.
- PWA Builder compliant with offline caching, maskable icons, and window controls overlay.
